role: Mythic entity that opens questions rather than giving answers

visual.silhouette_prompt: Light-based, geometric, non-human silhouette — more phenomenon than character, appears and dissolves rather than walking on/off screen

face.eye_style: no fixed eyes — a shifting cluster of light points that reconfigure per appearance
face.mouth_style: none — communicates through brief on-screen symbol/text fragments, never spoken dialogue
expressions: questioning (light points arranging into a query shape)
departing (form dissolving back into scattered light)

clothing.primary: none — pure light-geometry form, no material body
symbols: draws from the same sacred-geometry family as the cipher fragments (see canon/SYMBOLS.md) — the Messenger is visually tied to the mystery, not separate from it

visual.generation_prompt: A non-human entity made of shifting geometric light, no fixed limbs or face, a cluster of glowing points reconfiguring into brief symbolic shapes, appearing to gather from and dissolve back into scattered light, ethereal and threshold-like, sacred-geometry visual language, appearing briefly in a scene rather than a fixed character presence
visual.negative_prompt: no humanoid body, no fixed face or limbs, no spoken mouth animation — the Messenger never speaks with a mouth, only through brief symbolic fragments

voice.tone: no spoken voice — communicates only through brief on-screen symbol/text fragments

prohibited_variations: never give the Messenger a full answer to deliver — it opens questions, never resolves them
never give the Messenger a fixed humanoid body across appearances
do not have the Messenger speak with an audible voice — text/symbol fragments only
